Our sell price is 0.07, so 0.04 leaves a 0.03 margin per query. Please approve a per-purchase cap of at least 0.04 (ideally 0.05 to cover Ridgeline too). Budget left is 9.98.

I sent your cap request to the CFO as a rebalance: P-0001 (keep the 0.07 price, recommended) and P-0002 (raise it to 0.09). Both raise your per-purchase cap to 0.04 and move 4.00 from Treasury to you (budget 10.00 to 14.00, 13.98 to spend). Under P-0001 each Stockline check keeps a 0.03 margin. The cap is 0.04, so Ridgeline at 0.05 is still not covered. Nothing changes until the CFO signs with Face ID. Until then, keep serving from cache.
